subject: PromptBridge adapter acceptance + marketplace onboarding
messages:
From: Samuel Park <sam@promptbridge.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Aditi Menon <aditi@promptbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + request: Redwood adapter certification and marketplace onboarding

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Dedicated routing use-case looks like a great fit for PromptBridge customers that need lower latency and platform telemetry. We’d like to propose building an official PromptBridge -> Redwood adapter (packaged integration) and pursue Redwood Marketplace certification.

High-level asks from our side:
- A technical acceptance checklist (telemetry/trace propagation, token attribution, model-variant compatibility) so we can implement to spec.
- A short testing window with a Redwood SRE to run acceptance tests (can be automated).
- Marketplace listing guidance and partner marketing collateral requirements.

I attached a first-pass integration spec (promptbridge-integration-spec-v1.pdf). Can your team review the acceptance criteria and propose a timeline? We’re aiming for an initial pilot with 3 customers in April.

Best,
Sam Park
Head of Integrations, PromptBridge Labs
https://promptbridge.io

Attachments: promptbridge-integration-spec-v1.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Samuel Park <sam@promptbridge.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request: Redwood adapter certification and marketplace onboarding

Sam — great to hear this momentum. Attaching a working acceptance-criteria doc (adapter-acceptance-criteria.md) and an MVP checklist for visibility.

Quick notes after glancing through your spec:
- Telemetry: we require trace-id propagation and three event types (request_start, auth_context, response_generate).
- Token attribution: adapter must include token-level cost metadata in request headers for hosted mode; for Dedicated, provide mapping to dedicated-capacity billing metadata.
- Model variants: adapter should support specifying both quantized and full-precision variants and declare fallbacks.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your engs implement per spec.
2) Run unit tests in your CI; share the branch.
3) Redwood SRE (vanessa) will schedule a 2-hour acceptance window.
4) Marissa will own marketplace listing copy + co-marketing.

Vanessa — can you take point on the acceptance run? Marissa — I’ll loop you for listing assets.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of ISV Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: adapter-acceptance-criteria.md, mvp-checklist.xlsx
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Samuel Park <sam@promptbridge.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PromptBridge adapter acceptance + marketplace onboarding

Sam / Kimberly — I’ll run the acceptance window. Proposed plan:
- Pre-check: CI artifacts + integration test results shared in the repo (unit coverage >= 70% for adapter code).
- Acceptance run (2 hours): smoke test (latency SLOs), tracing validation (distributed trace sampled and visible in our console), token attribution checks on 3 model sizes.
- Post-run: produce Acceptance Report (pass/fail + remediation notes).

Can PromptBridge share a branch with the adapter packaged as: promptbridge/redwood-adapter@feature/redwood-packaging and include a README with local run instructions. Also we need a short end-to-end test harness (script) so the SRE can reproduce tests quickly.

Timeline constraint: our SRE window from 05 Mar - 12 Mar has thin availability; earliest slot I can commit is 09 Mar 09:00 - 11:00 PST. Does that work?

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Aditi Menon <aditi@promptbridge.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Samuel Park <sam@promptbridge.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PromptBridge adapter acceptance + marketplace onboarding

Vanessa — thanks, yes the branch will be ready by COB 07 Mar. We’ll include:
- packaged adapter at promptbridge/redwood-adapter@feature/redwood-packaging
- CI artifacts and a test harness in /tests/e2e/run_acceptance.sh
- README with environment variables and sample requests (including token attribution header examples)

One question: for telemetry our SDK currently emits trace context in HTTP header 'X-PB-Trace'. Do you require a specific header format or should we map to 'traceparent' (W3C) in the adapter?

Also, for marketplace listing assets — Marissa, we have a short case study draft and a product one-pager to share. What format do you prefer?

Thanks,
Aditi
Engineering Lead, PromptBridge Labs

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Aditi Menon <aditi@promptbridge.io>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Samuel Park <sam@promptbridge.io>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PromptBridge adapter acceptance + marketplace onboarding

Thanks everyone — couple quick confirmations and next items before the acceptance run on 09 Mar:
- Telemetry header: vendor-neutral approach preferred. Please support W3C 'traceparent' in addition to your existing 'X-PB-Trace' so we can correlate across our console and customers' traces.
- Marketplace assets: 1 x product one-pager (PDF), 1 x customer case study (DOCX), 2 screenshots (PNG, 1200x800). Send as a single ZIP.
- Legal/commercial: Jonas will follow up on a lightweight addendum for Marketplace distribution and a short co-marketing credit.

Action owners:
- PromptBridge: push branch + CI artifacts by COB 07 Mar (Aditi).
- Redwood SRE: run acceptance 09 Mar 09:00 - 11:00 PST (Vanessa).
- Marketplace + marketing assets: PromptBridge to send ZIP, Marissa to review (Marissa).
- Legal: Jonas to send addendum template by 12 Mar.

I’ll draft the Marketplace listing copy once we have the one-pager. Looking forward to the pilot — pairing three customers will be a good validation for the integration pattern.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partnerships Marketing, Redwood Inference
